lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Still lit. Twenty years and one more night.

lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Take the hammer — it was Okonkwo's grandmother's, and if he wants it back he can come and say so himself. And there's a man here who teaches people to hit a thing harder than the thing they're hitting with. He'll sit with you now. He would not have last week.
